display.purpose: Page titles. One per page surface.

headline.purpose: Section heads, card titles, exercise group names.

title.purpose: Sub-section labels, form field heads, modal titles.

body.purpose: Prose, workout notes, nutrition descriptions. Max 65–75ch line length.

label.purpose: Tags, axis labels, kbd hints, metadata. Never for body copy.

shadows.name: glass-ambient
shadows.purpose: Standard glass card. Top inset simulates light source.

shadows.name: input-inset
shadows.purpose: Recessed input field. Sits below card surface level.

shadows.name: button-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button hover only. State response, not ambient.

shadows.name: heatmap-peak
shadows.purpose: Intensity-4 heatmap cells only. Maximum effort indicator.

motion.name: ease-enter
motion.purpose: Entrances: slide-up, fade-in. Expo-out feel — fast start, soft land.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: State transitions: border-color, box-shadow, opacity, transform on hover.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Mobile/desktop split. px-4 below, px-6 above.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action. Submit workout, confirm parse, save nutrition log.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(0.65 0.22 160), oklch(0.7 0.18 195)); color: oklch(0.13 0.01 260); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; touch-action: manipulation; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px oklch(0.65 0.22 160 / 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.72 0.19 160); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Primary container for all content sections. The page's main structural element.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: oklch(0.18 0.012 260 / 0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.2); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.2); border: 1px solid oklch(0.3 0.015 260 / 0.5); border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.4 0.015 260 / 0.6); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05), 0 8px 32px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.3); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; }

components.name: Glass Input
components.description: Text input and textarea. Recessed below card surface to visually indicate 'enter data here'.
components.css: .ds-glass-input { display: block; width: 100%; background: oklch(0.14 0.01 260 / 0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.2); border: 1px solid oklch(0.3 0.015 260 / 0.4); border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.4 0.015 260 / 0.5); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.2), inset 0 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.05); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(0.92 0.01 260); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; outline: none; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-glass-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.55 0.01 260); } .ds-glass-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.72 0.19 160); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.65 0.22 160 / 0.15); }

components.name: Tag Pill
components.description: Workout type, exercise category, and activity labels. Compact semantic badges.
components.css: .ds-tag-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; background: oklch(0.65 0.22 160 / 0.12); color: oklch(0.72 0.19 160); border: 1px solid oklch(0.65 0.22 160 / 0.2); line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Stat Value
components.description: Numeric KPI display inside analytics cards and profile metrics. Always with context label.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.2; color: oklch(0.95 0.01 260); } .ds-stat-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.55 0.01 260); line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Heatmap Cell — Empty
components.description: Base calendar cell. No workout logged. 5 intensity levels plus rest variant.
components.css: .ds-heatmap-cell { width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: outline 0.1s ease; } .ds-heatmap-cell[data-intensity='0'] { background: oklch(0.2 0.012 260); border: 1px solid oklch(0.25 0.012 260); } .ds-heatmap-cell[data-intensity='1'] { background: oklch(0.35 0.12 160); border: 1px solid oklch(0.4 0.14 160 / 0.4); } .ds-heatmap-cell[data-intensity='2'] { background: oklch(0.48 0.16 160); border: 1px solid oklch(0.52 0.18 160 / 0.4); } .ds-heatmap-cell[data-intensity='3'] { background: oklch(0.6 0.2 160); border: 1px solid oklch(0.65 0.22 160 / 0.4); } .ds-heatmap-cell[data-intensity='4'] { background: oklch(0.72 0.22 160); border: 1px solid oklch(0.75 0.22 160 / 0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 6px oklch(0.72 0.22 160 / 0.3); } .ds-heatmap-cell[data-type='rest'] { background: oklch(0.45 0.15 280); border: 1px solid oklch(0.5 0.15 280 / 0.4); } .ds-heatmap-cell:hover { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.7 0.01 260 / 0.6); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Navigation Header
components.description: Sticky top header. Transparent at page top, gains border-bottom on scroll.
components.html:
🏋️ Frictionless
LogAnalyticsHistory
components.css: .ds-nav-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 24px; backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.2); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.2); background: oklch(0.15 0.01 260 / 0.8); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.3 0.015 260 / 0.3); } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.92 0.01 260); text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.01em; transition: filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-logo:hover { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px oklch(0.72 0.19 160 / 0.5)); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.55 0.01 260); text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; transition: color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(0.92 0.01 260); background: oklch(0.22 0.015 260); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: oklch(0.72 0.19 160); }

narrative.overview:
Frictionless is built for one person, in one context: standing in a gym, heart still elevated, phone in hand, wanting to log and close. The interface is not meant to be admired. It is meant to be used without friction, without thought, without hesitation. Every surface decision flows from that moment.

The palette is Deep Void Blue: blue-tinted dark neutrals that recede completely, pulling visual attention toward data. The single accent, Calibrated Emerald, is used precisely where action is required or status is meaningful. It does not appear decoratively. The blur-depth elevation system means depth is felt through glass, not cast through shadow. The whole system reads as dense, contained, calibrated — like the display of an instrument that cost too much to be ugly.

The system rejects everything that competes with its data: the cluttered calorie-counter energy of MyFitnessPal, the social-validation noise of Strava, the big-number hero clichés of SaaS dashboards, and the neon visual overload of cyberpunk interfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only. Not a mode, not a preference — a fixed decision for low-ambient, post-exertion use.
One accent. Emerald appears on primary actions, active states, and meaningful data signals only.
Glass depth. Blur and semi-transparency replace shadow stacking.
Tabular data density. Numbers sit in tabular-nums, weighted heavier than surrounding prose.
Expert-facing. No onboarding patterns, no tooltips on established UI, no confirmation theater.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Calibrated Emerald is the only interactive accent. Never used decoratively — no emerald dividers, headings, or icons that don't signal actionability or status.

rules.name: The Blue-Tint Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries hue 260 at chroma 0.01–0.015. Pure gray (oklch(L 0 0)) is prohibited.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value that changes or can be compared uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Weight-Contrast Rule
rules.body: Adjacent typography steps must differ by at least one weight increment. Never two consecutive steps at the same weight.

rules.name: The Blur-First Rule
rules.body: If you feel the urge to add a drop shadow to an element that isn't a glass panel or active button, add translucency and blur instead.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements carry no elevation at rest. Hover states introduce the glow. A lit button is a button the cursor is over — not a cosmetic default.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Glass Rule
rules.body: .glass-card inside .glass-card is always structural confusion. .glass-card > .glass-input is correct.

dos: Do use oklch for all color values. OKLCH is the source of truth.
Do apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to every numeric value that can change or be compared.
Do maintain the top-edge border highlight on all glass surfaces. It is the simulated light source.
Do make tap targets a minimum 44×44px on all interactive elements.
Do use full-perimeter borders on error states. Red is a perimeter treatment, never a side-stripe.
Do use reduced-motion guards on all keyframe animations.
Do use the emerald-to-cyan gradient exclusively on .btn-primary.
donts: Don't add a light mode. There is no light mode.
Don't add decorative emerald. Calibrated Emerald is an interactive signal only.
Don't nest glass cards inside glass cards.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't create hero-metric layouts: big number, small label, gradient accent, supporting stats.
Don't make the interface feel like MyFitnessPal, Strava, or any SaaS dashboard with identical card grids.
Don't add neon glows to surfaces or decorative elements. The only glows in the system are state-driven.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Animate transform and opacity only.
Don't add confirmation dialogs, tooltips, or onboarding overlays for actions a daily user knows.
